Set End to “Cheapest US arrival” if you don’t need to land back where you started — we’ll start and end anywhere in the US for the lowest total, so you can position to a cheap start city and take the cheapest way back into the country. Use Arrive to keep it on the mainland (no Hawaii) or bias to your coast so the last hop home is short. Loops are built from recently-tracked one-way fares — geography won’t always be textbook-perfect, and each leg’s live price is confirmed when you book on Aviasales. No full loop for some combinations — widen the regions, raise the budget, or change the stop count. Want a hand? Hire a consultant.
